summary: Papercups is now a first-class generic fixture: evidence data copied verbatim, drivers ported to strict-TS generic machinery (legacy-candidate-ingest.ts) parameterized by LegacyCandidateConfig, offline evidence verification (legacy-candidate-verify.ts, 22 checks incl. byte-exact attempt recomputation), tier-f FixtureId union and fixture:ingest/fixture:verify allowlists extended, 25 new tests. tsc, lint, the no-mjs guard, and all affected suites (95 tests) pass. `vp test --project node` fails only because the isolated worktree lacks the ~20GB gitignored .versionless corpus cache: all 91 failures are ENOENT under .versionless, none in files I touched.
open_questions: `pnpm exec vp test --project node` cannot pass in an isolated worktree: 34 pre-existing corpus suites need the gitignored ~20GB .versionless cache/work/stage trees that exist only in the main checkout. Should the gate for this unit be run in the main checkout after merge, or may a worker link/copy the main checkout's .versionless into its worktree (shared mutable state, risky while lanes run in parallel)?
